rules.statement: A tenant cannot deny a landlord's title to immovable property during the tenancy, but can show that the landlord has lost title after the commencement of the tenancy.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is sound law that a lessee cannot refuse to pay rent on the ground that the lessor had no title to the premises leased at the date of lease. It is equally good law, however, that he may prove that since the tenancy commenced the landlord's title has expired and that he has been evicted by title paramount."
